caption: The drawing depicts a circular emblem with multiple layered borders. The outermost border is green with a white geometric maze-like pattern, interrupted by several silver-tipped spears and red banners. Inside this is a wide, gold ring containing the words "THE GREAT SEAL OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA" in capital letters. Within the gold ring, the central circular image shows a female figure in a gold helmet and red robe, holding a spear in her left hand and a shield with a gold motif in her right arm. At her feet is a brown grizzly bear with its head facing forward. In the background, there are mountains colored in shades of green and gray, a body of water with white sails and brown-hulled ships, and several small, indistinct human figures. Farther behind are gold-colored mining tools and a reddish-gold pickaxe. Above the female figure, the word "EUREKA" is inscribed in blue letters on a gold background. The composition is intricate, combining elements of red, gold, green, white, blue, black, and brown.
title: Mosaic Marble "Ornament"
